_comment: Missions (Update 6). Three daily missions (one per tier) and one weekly mission are drawn from these pools, deterministically per day/week and profile (src/core/missions.gd). 'event' is the progress key: a Profile stat (bumped live during games: total_outs, cards_played, double_plays, boss_*, packs_opened, cards_upgraded ...) or an end-of-game event sent by Rewards.apply (win, win_diff:<difficulty>, cards_<category>, outs_by:<defender>, max_combo, daily_played, caught_stealing, clean_innings, games_played, endless_inning, win_streak). Update 9 adds boons_drafted (bumped live by the Dugout Draft), wins_boss_rush, shop_purchases (paid Daily Shop deals) and win_streak (the streak after a win, a 'max' event). Every claimed mission also pays 80 season XP (data/season.json). 'max' events count the best single game instead of adding up. '{n}' is the goal, '{who}' the defender, '{diff}' the difficulty. Rewards are sized against the Update 5 economy (about 3,200 coins and 10 packs per hour of play, tools/balance/economy.py): a full day of missions is worth about 525 coins (+50 % in the coin boost) and a Rookie Pack (about 17 % of an hour's income), the weekly mission a Pro Pack and 20 stars.

daily.text: Buy a deal in the Daily Shop
Finish {n} innings without allowing a run
Draft {n} boons in the Dugout Draft
Win a game on {diff} or harder
Catch {n} Base Stealers mid-steal (slow, stun or freeze them)

weekly.text: Win {n} Boss Rush games this week
Buy {n} Daily Shop deals this week

_starter_comment: The Rookie Path (Update 13, replaces the 5-step 'Learn the ropes' chain): ten steps shown on the hub, each teaching one feature, with escalating rewards. Claiming steps 3, 5, 7 and 9 also opens the next group of features (data/onboarding.json 'path'). 'reward' takes coins, stars, pack/packs; 'choice': 'free_agent' lets the player sign a locked free agent of their choice.

starter.hint: PLAY a Quick Defense game: drag defenders into place, then play cards on the runners.
CARD PACKS at the bottom of the hub: pick a pack and open it.

starter.text: Put a new card in your deck
starter.hint: CARDS & DECK: click a card from your collection, then SAVE the deck.
UPGRADE CARDS: copies from packs and coins level a card up.

starter.text: Pick a captain or change your team
starter.hint: TEAM: choose your starting six and a captain (BEST TEAM can pick for you).
Pick SIEGE under PLAY: the full nine-inning game with three bosses.
PLAY DAILY on the TODAY panel: one game a day, the same for every manager.

starter.text: Take the free gift in the Shop
starter.hint: SHOP: a free gift every day, plus deals on the cards you need.
The SEASON chip under the title: every game earns season XP.
Pick BOSS RUSH under PLAY. Rookie difficulty is a fine start.
